card.name: Linking words before postmarketing reports
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as during, through, case, cases, or use, just before phrases like post-marketing experience or case reports. They appear in sentences saying an event has been reported after a drug was on the market.

modes.label: Prepositions before post-marketing
modes.description: During or through right before post-marketing, post-approval, or marketed use.
modes.example: in individuals receiving buprenorphine in clinical trials and<< through>> post-marketing adverse event reports.

modes.label: Report nouns
modes.description: The words case, cases, or use inside phrases about reported cases.
modes.example: Based on findings from human<< case>> reports and animal studies, MATULANE

card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where the text is about to say that events were reported after the drug came to market.
